answer.en: No. Many teas contain caffeine, and cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Tea bags and loose tea leaves are the biggest risk. Don't share your tea, and call your vet if your cat chews a tea bag or drinks caffeinated tea.
answer.sl: Ne. Veliko čajev vsebuje kofein, mačke pa so nanj bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Največje tveganje predstavljajo čajne vrečke in suhi čajni listi. Čaja ne delite z muco in pokličite veterinarja, če prežveči čajno vrečko ali popije čaj s kofeinom.

why.en: Many teas contain caffeine. Cats are more sensitive to caffeine than people. Caffeine belongs to the methylxanthines, the same group of stimulants as the theobromine in chocolate, and it speeds up the heart, makes cats restless and upsets the stomach.
why.sl: Veliko čajev vsebuje kofein. Mačke so na kofein bolj občutljive kot ljudje. Kofein spada med metilksantine, isto skupino poživil kot teobromin v čokoladi, ter pospeši srce, povzroči nemir in prebavne težave.

en: Restlessness, jitteriness, not wanting to lie still
Fast heartbeat or heart rhythm changes
sl: Nemir, živčnost, muca ne more mirovati
Hiter srčni utrip ali spremembe srčnega ritma

what_to_do.en: Contact your vet or a pet poison helpline right away. Note what your cat swallowed (drink, grounds, beans, tea bag or tablets), how much and when. Don't wait for signs to appear, and don't try to make your cat sick at home.
what_to_do.sl: Takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Zapišite, kaj je muca zaužila (pijačo, mleto kavo, zrna, čajno vrečko ali tablete), koliko in kdaj. Ne čakajte na znake in muce doma ne poskušajte spraviti k bruhanju.

child.en: Tea is for people. Keep cups and used tea bags away from kitty, and tell a grown-up if she gets into them.
child.sl: Čaj je za ljudi. Skodelice in uporabljene čajne vrečke naj bodo daleč od muce. Če jih najde, povej odraslemu.

a.en: Yes. Pet Poison Helpline warns that eating tea bags could cause serious toxicity in cats. Throw used tea bags away where your cat can't reach them.
a.sl: Da. Pet Poison Helpline opozarja, da lahko zaužite čajne vrečke pri mačkah povzročijo resno zastrupitev. Uporabljene vrečke zavrzite tja, kamor muca ne seže.

chocolate, coffee and foods containing caffeine

Pets that consume caffeine may have an increased heart rate and become hyperactive.
They can get jittery and restless and do not want to lie still.
Caffeine also affects the gastrointestinal tract and can cause stomach upset.
signs of hyperactivity, gastrointestinal upset, changes in heart rate, rhythm and blood pressure
Call your veterinarian or Pet Poison Helpline, a 24/7 animal poison center,
